title: main: parse_args collects args to Vec then uses index loop
description: main.rs parse_args: collects std::env::args() into Vec<String> then iterates with a manual index counter i to find --config <path>. Idiomatic Rust: iterate with .windows(2) or use env::args().skip(1) with a peekable iterator, avoiding the Vec allocation and index mutation. The current form is a C-style loop pattern.
